# Ginger

deceased

## Overview

- **Gender:** male  <sub>[v2 III Mr. Harrison at Home P3](../source/v02-c03.md#nw-v02-c03-p0003), [v2 III Mr. Harrison at Home P18](../source/v02-c03.md#nw-v02-c03-p0018), [v2 III Mr. Harrison at Home P36](../source/v02-c03.md#nw-v02-c03-p0036)</sub>
- **Status:** deceased  <sub>[v2 XXIV A Prophet in His Own Country P43](../source/v02-c24.md#nw-v02-c24-p0043), [v2 XXV An Avonlea Scandal P59](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0059)</sub>

## Appearance

Ginger is a caged bird featuring vibrant green and gold plumage. He possesses a set of tail feathers and is distinguished by his wicked golden eyes.

_Sources: [v2 III Mr. Harrison at Home P3](../source/v02-c03.md#nw-v02-c03-p0003), [v2 III Mr. Harrison at Home P36](../source/v02-c03.md#nw-v02-c03-p0036), [v2 IX A Question of Color P22](../source/v02-c09.md#nw-v02-c09-p0022)_

## Personality

Ginger is an imitative and highly suspicious bird with a distinctly unholy and profane temperament. Known for being incorrigibly skilled at terrible swearing, the bird frequently greets others in a sarcastic manner.

_Sources: [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P10](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0010), [v2 III Mr. Harrison at Home P6](../source/v02-c03.md#nw-v02-c03-p0006), [v2 III Mr. Harrison at Home P38](../source/v02-c03.md#nw-v02-c03-p0038), [v2 IV Different Opinions P28](../source/v02-c04.md#nw-v02-c04-p0028), [v2 XXV An Avonlea Scandal P57](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0057)_

## History

Ginger was a parrot originally owned by Mr. Harrison's sailor brother, who named him and sent him to Mr. [Harrison](../character/harrison.md) before dying. During his time with Mr. [Harrison](../character/harrison.md), Ginger bit a piece out of John Henry's neck, swore aloud during grace while visiting ministers were present, and ultimately caused the breakdown of Mr.

_Sources: [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P10](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0010), [v2 III Mr. Harrison at Home P2](../source/v02-c03.md#nw-v02-c03-p0002), [v2 III Mr. Harrison at Home P4](../source/v02-c03.md#nw-v02-c03-p0004), [v2 III Mr. Harrison at Home P6](../source/v02-c03.md#nw-v02-c03-p0006), [v2 III Mr. Harrison at Home P7](../source/v02-c03.md#nw-v02-c03-p0007), [v2 III Mr. Harrison at Home P8](../source/v02-c03.md#nw-v02-c03-p0008), +186 more_
